# Kibo UI Roadmap

Source: [Roadmap block](https://www.kibo-ui.com/blocks/roadmap) and the [Kibo repository](https://github.com/shadcnblocks/kibo). Upstream license: MIT.

These local copies of Gantt, Calendar, List and Kanban came from `component-staging/component-lab`. The customer service records route composes them in read-only mode, synchronizes visible dates, and adapts missing UI primitives locally. The fifth Roadmap view uses this project's existing DataTable so its behavior and permissions stay consistent with Next Dashboard. Vendor changes are limited to presentation and read-only interaction.
